features.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Matrix
features.subtitle: 9 specialized cognitive agents collaborating locally to understand your intent, observe your screen, and control physical desktop and mobile interfaces.
features.f1_desc: Native Windows UI automation using PyAutoGUI & Win32 APIs. Opens apps, edits files, and manages windows effortlessly.
features.f2_desc: Sub-120ms conversational audio streaming with interruption awareness, local whisper transcription, and neural voice synthesis.
features.f3_desc: Real-time multi-monitor OCR and visual grounding. Analyzes errors, reads UI layouts, and navigates complex software.
features.f4_desc: Seamlessly controls connected Android devices over Wi-Fi. Launches apps, sends messages, and taps coordinates autonomously.
features.f5_desc: Playwright-powered Chromium automation with undetectable browser fingerprinting, ad-blocking, and parallel research scraping.
features.f6_desc: Zero telemetry and air-gapped core architecture. Your screen data, keystrokes, and audio remain on your hardware.

architecture.title: Hybrid Brain & Multi-Agent Loop
architecture.subtitle: Local ultra-fast orchestration coupled with Gemini Live streaming for millisecond-level responsiveness.
architecture.ceoDesc: Decomposes complex requests into directed acyclic dependency graphs and delegates subtasks to specialized agents.
architecture.memoryDesc: Local SQLite-backed semantic vector storage for instant recall of past conversations, files, and user preferences.
architecture.safetyDesc: Human-in-the-loop confirmation for critical file deletions, system reboots, and network shell commands.

simulator.title: Test Multi-Agent Execution
simulator.subtitle: Select a command below to watch the autonomous CEO agent delegate tasks across screen vision, browser, and mobile bridges in real-time.

security.title: Zero Telemetry. 100% Air-Gapped by Design.
security.subtitle: Your keystrokes, personal screen, audio input, and terminal executions never leave your local hardware without explicit approval.
security.p1_desc: All API keys, session histories, and local memories are encrypted with AES-256 GCM using Windows DPAPI keys.
security.p2_desc: Complete source code visibility. Zero hidden analytics, zero trackers, and zero background analytics beaconing.
security.p3_desc: Optionally run local offline LLM backends (Ollama, LM Studio) without requiring an internet connection.
